global.title: Saudi Arabia’s stc Group orders small GEO satellite in another Astranis Block 3 reshuffle
global.summary: TAMPA, Fla. — Saudi telecoms giant stc Group has become Astranis’ second broadband satellite customer from the Middle East, alongside Oman-based industrial conglomerate MB Group. The Saudi company replaced one of two satellites Mexican telco Apco Networks had booked as part of the manufacturer’s delayed Block 3 mission, according to an Astranis spokesperson. MB Group earlier took a spot on Block 3 that had been held by Orbits Corp of the Philippines.
